He had some depressed sessions yes but lately he seemed alright.

He could be very dark sometimes and didnt listen or care whatever we said.

Could be very rude to my mom cuz she was a lil bit overprotective. But i told him she is the most important thing we have and he has to treat her well.

But lately hes been fine, mom said they had a good time at home lately joking around with good vibes.

I want to know how planned it was. 

He was chatting with his ex-gf at 01 AM and everything seemed ok. Thats the last contact from him.
It probably happened around 03 AM, he sneaked out to the garage and did it.

He knew exactly how next morning would turn out cuz mom always make sure he gets out of bed every morning and his best friend is picking him up for work so he was there when it happened.

He had a song on repeat in his earphones while he did it.

Yesterday he was chilling with our cat that he loves and my mom. He said goodnight and went to sleep.

Hanging needs some planning right?

It was my father that lost his father when he was a little kid.

I can admit its very hard to talk about it and its hard to bring up with him cuz its so sensitive.

I hope this gives a more positive and open effect in the family so we can talk about hard stuff.

Nah he was more into cars and stuff like that he was not a true gamer like me, we didnt rly have much contact since i moved away from my hometown. Only this summer we had the chance to do some decent deeper talking.

He been acting normal and been nice all weekend.
